StopCore.Name: Stop Foundry's playlists when the deck plays
StopCore.Hint: When the deck starts a track, stop any of Foundry's own playlists playing on the same channel, so two songs never play over each other.

Precise.Name: Sample-accurate loops
Precise.Hint: Decode arranged tracks up to 10 minutes long into memory (about 23 MB per minute), so loops and jumps land on the exact sample. Off: stream every track, which uses little memory but crossfades loop seams. Turn off on computers short of memory.

Lite.Name: Skip heavy effects on this computer
Lite.Hint: Leave out the deck's reverb and pitch shifting on this computer. The music stays in step; it just sounds drier. For computers that struggle.

Deck.Name: Music deck
Deck.Label: Open the deck
Deck.Hint: Play tracks for everyone with sections, seeking, speed, pitch and effects.

Shrink.Name: Shrink an audio or video file
Shrink.Label: Open the shrink tool
Shrink.Hint: Turn a long video or a large audio file into a small Opus file and add it to a playlist.

Notify.GMOnly: Only a GM (or an assistant allowed to change world settings) can control the deck.

Sidebar.Load: Load into the deck (Shift: play now)
Sidebar.NowPlaying: Playing in the Dal Segno deck

Deck.Title: Dal Segno deck
Deck.Empty: Pick a track above. Click to load it for everyone without starting it; the play button starts it.
Deck.CueHint: Load for everyone, ready to start (Shift: play now)
Deck.PreciseHint: Decoded in memory: loops and jumps land on the exact sample.
Deck.StreamedHint: Streamed from the server: starts at once and uses little memory; loop seams are crossfaded.
Deck.GotoHint: Go to this section when the current one finishes its pass (Shift: now)
Deck.SeekHint: Click to jump here for everyone
Deck.TimingHint: When Next, Ending and the section buttons take effect: at the end of the current pass (a loop finishes its phrase), or straight away with a short crossfade. Shift-click does the other.
Deck.AtBoundary: At the end of the pass
Deck.NextHint: Move on to the next section (Shift: now)
Deck.EndingHint: Go to the last section (Shift: now)
Deck.AutoNext: Play the next track in the playlist when one ends
Deck.LoopQueue: Start the playlist over after the last track
Deck.Keys: Keys for play, next and ending can be set under Configure Controls.
Deck.NotInPlaylist: This track isn't in a playlist, so it has no saved sections to edit.

Fx.KeepPitch: Keep the pitch when the speed changes
Fx.Hint: Every player hears these. Pitch shifts beyond a few semitones get grainy. Players who turned on "Skip heavy effects" hear no reverb or pitch shift.

Editor.Title: Sections
Editor.Loading: Reading the file for its waveform…
Editor.TooLong: This file is over 20 minutes, so there is no waveform (it would take too much memory); place markers by listening, with the preview and the cursor.
Editor.NoWave: No waveform ({error}). Sections can still be set by time.
Editor.Waveform: Waveform: click to place the preview cursor, drag a marker to move it
Editor.Zoom: Close-up of the selected marker: drag to fine-tune it
Editor.SeamHint: Play from three seconds before the loop goes round, so you can hear the join
Editor.MatchHint: Move the selected loop's end to the nearby point whose sound best matches the loop's start, so the join is smooth
Editor.Matched: Loop end moved to {end} s ({score}% match).
Editor.Hint: Sections play top to bottom; a looping section repeats until you move on, and anything between sections is skipped. Previews play only on your computer.
Editor.Label: Name
Editor.NoSections: No sections: the whole file plays as it is.
Editor.PresetAdjust: Three sections added at rough positions: drag their markers to the real intro and ending.
Editor.CrossfadeHint: How long jumps and loop seams crossfade. 0 is a hard cut, right for tracks made to loop; streamed tracks always use at least 0.15 s.
Editor.Cleared: Sections removed from {name}; it plays straight through.

Shrink.Title: Shrink a file
Shrink.Intro: Turns the sound of a long video or a large audio file into a small Opus file and uploads it. It runs in your browser: a file from your computer is never sent anywhere but your Foundry server.
Shrink.Unsupported: This browser can't shrink files: it needs WebCodecs audio support (Chrome, Edge, recent Firefox, or the Foundry desktop app).
Shrink.CantRead: This file's audio can't be read here, and it is too large to decode in one piece.
Shrink.Name: File name
